strongs_1890.strongs_def: (adjectively) at home; hence (by implication of satisfaction) lovely; also (noun) a home, of God (temple), men (residence), flocks (pasture), or wild animals (den)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: comely, dwelling (place), fold, habitation, pleasant place, sheepcote, stable, tarried.
